floats.label: tab:calib_lodo
floats.note: appendix leave-one-domain-out calibration probe; also carries the body paragraph's bounded-transfer claim for the margin-mass statistic M (paper_a2/ext_partII_domains.tex, prose rather than a float), generated by tools/_p1614_a23_multi_encoder_transfer.py into outputs/analysis/a23_multiencoder_transfer.json (fields: conclusion.n_encoders, conclusion.n_corpora, conclusion.n_units, conclusion.n_ordered_pairs, conclusion.n_statistics_per_pair, conclusion.n_scored_entries_cross_unit, conclusion.n_entries_above_chance, conclusion.n_entries_surviving_bootstrap, conclusion.answer, conclusion.best_surviving_pair.{source,target,statistic,target_BA,source_fit_BA,delta_ci95,p_delta_gt_zero}, transfer.self_pairs, transfer.cross_unit_pairs, transfer.summary.n_scored_entries_self_pairs, transfer.pairs[].by_statistic.*.bootstrap.{survives,target_BA,delta_vs_chance_ci95}, limits.probes.single_seed, limits.class_imbalance.corpus_class_counts, limits.list, encoders.<encoder>.corpora.<corpus>.frozen_row.top1, encoders.<encoder>.corpora.<corpus>.chance_percent, encoders.<encoder>.corpora.<corpus>.reproduction.max_abs_diff). Seven-encoder run 2026-10-25 (meta.finished_at 2026-10-25T07:39:56+0800, script sha1 ee174963df00583822b4d70f30f8da450dda3fbb, meta.git a834c33e clean): 7 encoders x 3 corpora, 21 units, 441 ordered pairs, 21 self-pairs excluded from the claim (260 scored self-pair entries; 533 of the 5733 pair-statistic entries are degenerate and carry target_BA = null), 4940 scored cross-unit entries, 179 nominally above chance (chance 0.50), 29 image-bootstrap survivors (2.5th percentile of target BA - chance > 0 over 2000 refitted draws; paired within a corpus, unpaired across corpora), verdict 'yes for at least one pair' (conclusion.answer). (the per-encoder survivor counts and the 16/13 source split are an aggregation of transfer.pairs[].{target_encoder,source_corpus,self_pair} x by_statistic.*.bootstrap.survives over the non-self pairs, not a stored scalar). Boundary: all 29 survivors target the single acoustic_sonar corpus (12 on siglip-base-patch16-224, 10 on oceanclip, 6 on remoteclip, 1 on clip-vit-large-patch14; sources acoustic_sonar 16 / rare_species 13; 16 of 29 paired) and 27 of 29 are the sigma-relative statistics M(eps/sigma_D) at c in {0.005,0.01,0.02} (12, 10, 5); the optical and the 67-class rare-species target corpora contribute none. Strongest survivor bioclip__acoustic_sonar -> siglip-base-patch16-224__acoustic_sonar on mass_0p002: target BA 0.900, source fit BA 0.500 (what transfers is the direction, not a calibrated level), delta CI95 [+0.100,+0.500], p_delta_gt_zero 0.992, 9 distinct source and target values. Limits kept in the text: nine configurations per unit (median-split label), class-imbalanced corpora, single probe split seed for the probe-based encoders, declared extraction paths rather than official reference pipelines, and the encoder this run adds - remoteclip, a remote-sensing fine-tune whose zero-shot top-1 sits within a factor of two of chance on all three corpora (12.83 / 11.27 / 2.43 % against 14.29 / 14.29 / 1.49 %), so 6 of the 29 survivors take their target from it; its checkpoint models/RemoteCLIP/RemoteCLIP-ViT-B-32.pt hashes to sha256 60014e395d930a3f2963d1d89c8522bf4ad56775571e4356e866864789af85c4, identical to the chendelong/RemoteCLIP LFS object, and loads with 0 missing / 0 unexpected keys, so its chance-level result is a property of the encoder on these corpora rather than an unloaded model. The four units shared with the two certificates reproduce them exactly (max |diff| = 0.0 over 128 compared values on four units). Superseded six-encoder run of the same script: 18 units / 324 ordered pairs / 3536 scored cross-unit entries / 124 nominal / 19 survivors (11 siglip + 8 oceanclip, all acoustic_sonar targets), preserved at git HEAD.
